column2: [intro]
In my little peaceful corner,
I wander and smile with wonder,
The people around, they captivate me,
Their behavior, it’s a sight to see.
I love to watch the passersby,
Their quirks and faces catch my eye.
In this gentle ambiance,
I feel at home, it's like a dance!
There’s the hurried man, rushing all around,
The stylish woman, never without makeup, found,
The grumpy old man, lamenting his plight,
And the giggling baby, making faces with delight.
I love observing people’s charm,
Their gestures, their faces, a visual balm.
In this odd world, so full of grace,
I always find inspiration for my music’s embrace!
[ solo ]
I love observing the people near,
Their quirks, their faces so clear.
In this soothing ambiance,
I feel at home, it’s like a trance!
[outro]
